items.title: File Widerspruch against the Unterhaltsvorschuss decision
items.quote: Er muss innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe des Bescheids bei uns eingehen (Kreisverwaltung Musterhunsrück, Schlossplatz 7, 55469 Musterbach im Hunsrück); Sie können ihn schriftlich einreichen oder bei uns zur Niederschrift erklären.
items.computation: The letter is dated Thu 19.11.2026 and was sent by an authority by ordinary post, and the letter itself states that a posted Bescheid counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X). Posting day = 19.11.2026 (Thursday); 4th day after = Mon 23.11.2026 (no weekend/holiday shift applies to this deemed-delivery rule). The one-month Widerspruch period then starts the next day (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB / § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X) and ends one month later on the day with the same number, i.e. Wed 23.12.2026 (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB). 23.12.2026 is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in Rheinland-Pfalz, so no further shift is needed.

items.title: Report immediately if the father pays maintenance or you move
items.quote: Teilen Sie uns bitte sofort mit, wenn er Unterhalt an Sie zahlt oder Sie umziehen.
items.computation: The letter requires 'sofort' (immediate) notification if either triggering event occurs, but gives no calendar date and the events (payment by the father, or moving) have not occurred as of this letter — so no fixed due date can be computed; the duty is ongoing and triggers only when one of the named events happens.

items.title: Unterhaltsvorschuss monthly payment to the person
items.quote: für Ihre Tochter Marie zahlen wir ab dem 01.11.2026 Unterhaltsvorschuss nach dem Unterhaltsvorschussgesetz in Höhe von 293,00 € monatlich.
items.computation: This is a recurring monthly payment the authority will make to the recipient starting 01.11.2026; the letter sets the amount and start month but no further single due date beyond the recurring monthly disbursement, so it is recorded as an ongoing payment from that start date rather than a one-off deadline.

warnings: The IBAN printed in the letterhead (DE54 5605 0180 0008 2004 00) is well-formed, but since this letter informs you of a payment TO you (not a request for you to pay), there is no reason to send money to this account; be wary of any later message asking you to pay the Jugendamt via this or another IBAN in connection with this case.

The 'report immediately' duty to notify the Unterhaltsvorschusskasse if the father pays maintenance or you move has no fixed date in the letter — it is an ongoing obligation triggered by those events, not a one-time deadline.
